embeds.title: 🛒 Ready to order?
embeds.description:
Tell us what mess you're walking into. We'll reply within **24h**, then plan + price straight up.

Most builds go live in **3–7 days**.

fields.name: How it works
fields.value:
1. Pick a package in <#942775701877182474> (or on the site)
2. Open a ticket here **or** order online
3. We read your brief within 24h
4. Quick call if needed — no calendar hell
5. You go live

fields.name: What to include in your ticket
fields.value:
• Server invite / niche
• Package you want (Kickoff / Autopilot / Full Send)
• What's broken (roles, welcome, bots, branding…)
• Deadline if you have one
